}}{{TIDTOC|switch}} ==Overview== :• "milkV", "MV025 V1.11" and "20231204" are silkscreened on the board top.
===Hardware specification=== *Processor: ''Fisilink'' FSL1030M Network Switch Chip :with Embedded RISC-V UX608 uCore @400MHz *Storage: 4MB (SPI NOR), 128MB (NAND) Flash *Memory: 256MB (DDR3L) SDRAM *SFP: 2x 10G SFP+, 4x 1G SFP slots *LAN: 8x GbE ports *Power Source: 12V/2A via barrel
